svg.title: Psynergy on the field, step by step
svg.desc: At the top, the cast as the game plays it: the screen tints, Move's hand pushes the pillar, and the colours come back. Isaac uses Move on the stone pillar in Vale. First the game checks Psynergy can be used here (not in the Battle Arena, not Reveal on the world map, not Retreat where it is blocked) and takes the PP. Then it runs the map's event for before the cast, if the map has one. Then the effect plays: Move's hand appears, and it pushes the thing ahead only because the map has an event for Move on that pillar; with no such event the hand pushes at nothing. Last it runs the map's event for after the cast: in Vale, noting where the pillar now stands and making its new cell solid. The map decides what happens; the effect only draws it.
svg.text: ISAAC USES MOVE ON VALE'S STONE PILLAR

there, the hand pushes at nothing.
Vale notes where the pillar now stands,
and makes its new cell solid.
The map decides; the effect only draws.
